note: The lanes, priorities, and actor-grouped transition allow-list for a localswim board. User definitions live in each board JSON. Under edges, each actor id maps to permitted directed edges with required from and to fields and an optional description. Schema 6 introduced this grouping and renamed the former edge note field to description.

lanes.label: Backlog
lanes.note: Someday. Terry's queue, and the only lane Claude may CREATE in besides Ready for Claude. Terry gained create here on 2026-08-19 for the + button in the lane header (card #0038). He could always ADD a card -- by asking Claude to run the CLI -- so this grants him the keystroke rather than the power.

lanes.label: Ready For Work
lanes.note: Do this next, in priority order. Terry fills it; Claude empties it. CREATING here is not PROMOTING here -- Claude files a card he just asked for in chat, but only Terry moves one in from the backlog, so Claude can never advance its own queue. Terry gained create here on 2026-08-19 for the + button (card #0038). CREATING here is still not PROMOTING here: the create right and the backlog->ready_for_claude edge are separate entries, and Claude has the first unconditionally and the second only per-ticket. RENAMED 2026-08-19: the LABEL is now "Ready For Work" and the stored id stays ready_for_claude. Terry: "we're going to do enough network server work I don't want RFC to be a namespace collision." The collision is in SPEECH -- nobody abbreviates the id -- so renaming the label fixes it and renaming the id would rewrite every history entry on 51 cards for no gain. Card #0034.

lanes.label: In progress
lanes.note: Being worked now. Claude's lane end to end.

lanes.label: Blocked
lanes.note: NEITHER of us can move it. Terry's example: "awaiting license key." MUST NOT be used for "waiting on a decision" -- that is needs_terry_action -- and MUST NOT be used for "hard".

lanes.label: Needs Terry
lanes.note: Claude is STOPPED until Terry answers. His definition: "that's 'need a judgement call'." Distinct from blocked, where nobody can act, and from review, where the work is done and only a tick is missing.

lanes.label: Ready for review
lanes.note: Claude believes it is done and is waiting on a signoff. This is as far as Claude may take anything.

lanes.label: Completed
lanes.note: Terminal. An empty `out` IS append-only, enforced by the same rule as everything else rather than by a special flag.

terry.description: Terry promotes from the backlog, and that is what makes the queue his. CLAUDE HAS THIS EDGE AND MUST NOT USE IT UNSOLICITED. Terry, 2026-08-19: "If something changes on a ticket in backlog that suddenly makes it eligible for work, Terry can grant *per-ticket* permission to move from backlog to RFW. Note that claude MUST NOT move out of backlog until/unless Terry gives explicit guidance for one specific ticket." The grant is PER TICKET and verbal; the table cannot express that, so the restraint lives in CLAUDE.md and ORIENTATION.md. A standing permission read off this row alone would let Claude fill its own queue, which is the one thing every other edge here is shaped to prevent.
Terry starting something straight out of his own queue. Claude has no such edge and MUST NOT gain one -- promotion out of the backlog is what makes the queue his.

Terry pulling one of his own someday cards forward as a REMINDER TO HIMSELF. Terry, 2026-08-19: "add a state machine perms rule to allow terry to move from Backlog to Needs Terry... Trying to leave myself a reminder." The lane note frames this lane as "Claude is STOPPED until Terry answers", and this row widens it by one reading: Needs Terry is the only lane the title bar counts as HIS call to action, so it is where a thing he must personally do belongs, whether or not Claude waits on it. It grants no power he lacked -- he already owned backlog->ready_for_claude and backlog->in_progress -- it grants the honest destination.

Claude may push a card BACKWARDS. Terry, 2026-08-19: "yes claude can push backwards from RFW to backlog. In progress to Backlog or RFW. from blocked to any swimlane left of it. from needs terry to any lane left of it." Setting work down is not advancing a queue, which is what the forward edges guard.
